evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server request parsing and state handling in src/httpserver.{h,cpp}.
rationale: Internal encapsulation cleanup improves robustness by enforcing HTTP request state transitions at compile time instead of relying on caller convention. As noted in the discussion, removing SetState() closes an encapsulation gap from PR 35829 where external callers could arbitrarily mutate internal state, but it resolves no active bug or user-visible issue.
